description: Shows what a branded page (…/r/<slug>) currently says: name, description, colour, video, whether it has a logo or background, and whether people are in its room right now. Use it before changing a page or to check a slug the user mentions. Read-only; needs no key.

slug.description: The slug after /r/, or the whole public link.

name: get_branded_link

code.description: Error code when ok is false.

live.description: Someone is in the room now.

ok.description: false when the call failed; then code says why.

video_url.description: Video the room opens with, if any.

title: Look up a branded link
